'''Giles Emery''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Melbourne tournament]] on 15 July 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down/Podracing]], according to Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2652">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-melbourne-australie-15-07-01d2652/ melbourne-australie-15-07-01], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 17 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-melbourne-australie-15-07-01d2652/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
